newsitem.title: USA: US cash crudes end with push higher, grades quiet.
newsitem.headline: US cash crudes end with push higher, grades quiet.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes ended firmer Monday, gaining on support from heating oil rallying due to tight supplies, effectively reversing early technical selling.

At the same time outright crude prices fluctuated widely, the domestic grade business quieted to a whisper. Only a few deals were confirmed all session, leaving many players wondering where all the action went.
"It was quiet, we only saw one West Texas Sour get done and some postings," said one crude broker.
March West Texas Intermediate/Cushing closed out 20 cents higher at $22.40-50 a barrel, with Mar/Apr WTI at 23 cts.
